methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of this paper is to identify main success factors for the effective implementation, operation and certification of an energy management system (EnMS) in accordance with ISO 50001

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy performance indicators are mentioned only incidentally (an audit-report optimization topic and an employee training area); the paper is a survey of organizational success factors, team composition and certification approaches for ISO 50001 EnMS implementation and identifies or characterises no EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: among already certified German companies has been conducted focussing on organizational, teambuilding and technical aspects

stage1.notes: Survey of 121 ISO 50001-certified German companies on organizational/team success factors; EnPI mentioned incidentally only, no measurement model characterised.
